voicePage.title: Voice Assistant
voicePage.subtitle: Speak a question and get a grounded, cited answer from the same Learner Assistant -- your voice never leaves this session, and nothing is written to disk.
voicePage.micDenied: Microphone access was denied or is unavailable. Allow microphone access and try again.
voicePage.connectionError: Could not connect to the voice assistant. Please try again.
voicePage.ttsUnavailable: Voice reply unavailable (no local voice model configured) -- showing the text answer instead.
voicePage.footerNote: Audio is processed live and never saved. If no spoken reply plays, the text answer above is still real and grounded.
